criteria.name: Pixel-ratio arithmetic
criteria.description: Computes storm/pre cloud-like and bright-pixel ratios from the stated RGB thresholds.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for one exact ratio or both ratios with minor rounding drift.

criteria.name: Rainfall contrast arithmetic
criteria.description: Computes the gridded maximum, cross-product maximum-value spread, and reported-rainfall-to-grid ratio.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct gridded maximum with a small ratio or spread error.

criteria.name: Text-marker count and formula use
criteria.description: Counts the five report markers and applies every threshold component in the 0-6 ledger formula.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct marker count with one missing formula component.

criteria.name: Change and wind terms
criteria.description: Uses the annual cosine mean, dNBR mean, and event-window maximum daily wind value in the numeric ledger.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for using two of the three terms correctly.

criteria.name: Final JSON and units
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with score, ratios, millimeter values, marker count, flags, and units.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points when values are mostly correct but the JSON is incomplete.

criteria.name: Numeric synthesis
criteria.description: Shows how the component subtotal and wind term produce the final score of 6 out of 6.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the right final score with a thin component ledger.

provenance.pixel_rule: bright mean RGB >= 220; cloud-like RGB channels >= 200 with channel spread <= 35
